correctness.rationale: For fixed α, the two zero-product conditions force β's source into the complement of im α and its target into the complement of dom α. Both lists have size m=n−r; their intersection of size c consists exactly of α's isolated vertices. Every β cycle lives in this intersection. In inclusion–exclusion an overlapping selection of distinct cycles is impossible; disjoint selections on j vertices give a permutation there, times a remaining rank-(s−j) matching between lists of size m−j. Their signed sum is (−1)^j times the sum of permutation signs, hence zero for j≥2 by a transposition pairing. This proves the displayed conditional two-term formula, including s=0 when the correction is absent. Summing uses the Lah census for m ordered-internally but unlabeled chains and n L(n−1,m−1) marked singletons. For m≥2, both terms share the stated factorial factor and leave (n−1)m and (m−1)s, respectively; their difference is (n−1)h+rs. For m=1 and n≥2, α is a spanning chain and the unique possible nonempty β is the rank-one link from its initial vertex to its final vertex, so the counts agree at s=0,1. The n=1 case, support restriction and positive boundary formula follow. A separate chain-list generation and direct composition test checks every joint rank cell and every fixed-α conditional rank count for n=1 through 5, giving totals 1,7,55,565,7141.
residual_risks: The frozen script reports n=6 as well; independent replay here is bounded to n≤5. The proof, not either finite test, establishes the general count.

value.rationale: The full joint census resolves how feasible ranks trade off when each factor is nilpotent and both products vanish. Its support and simple positive boundary (with counts n! times a binomial coefficient) are interpretable without summing an ambient product distribution. The conditional overlap statistic explains why individual chain lengths beyond isolated vertices are irrelevant for this relation. Neither a one-map Lah count nor unrestricted annihilation statistics answer this rank-refined question.
residual_risks: Value is assigned to the exact two-factor result, not an assertion that cycle inclusion–exclusion itself is new or that the census extends to arbitrary commuting pairs.
